title: Play Credit Bundles: usage-contoured grants + enterprise SQ checkpoint
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Increase meaningful product usage from free signups and surface higher-quality leads for AE + SQ path. Hypothesis: Replacing a single one-size starter credit grant with two coordinated bundles (a short high-velocity bundle for rapid evaluation + a measured longer tail bundle for continued exploration) will increase 14-day active retention by 12% and double SQL conversion velocity for accounts that hit the Enterprise Security Questionnaire (SQ) checkpoint.

Background: Current free-credit experience often results in early token burn with no sustained retention. Enterprise prospects get stuck at the SQ step where they must re-request access or open a support ticket; this causes drop-off. We want to experiment with: (1) credit shape — size and TTL across two bundles; (2) contextual upgrade prompts tied to in-product events; (3) an SQ checkpoint flow that grants an extension/temporary reserved credits after the customer submits the SQ to keep momentum.

Experiment design:
- Cohorts: randomize new signups into three cohorts (control, split-bundle A, split-bundle B).
- Bundles:
  * Control: 100k starter tokens, 30d expiry (current baseline).
  * Split A: 60k high-velocity tokens, 7d expiry (fast trial) + 50k tail tokens, 60d expiry (longer exploration).
  * Split B: 80k high-velocity, 5d expiry + 40k tail, 90d expiry (tests different tail duration).
- In-product hooks: contextual banners when prefix usage reaches 70% of high-velocity bundle offering upgrade hints with A/B tested microcopy (CTA: "Upgrade for predictable throughput" vs "Reserve capacity for production").
- SQ checkpoint: when an enterprise user submits the Security Questionnaire form, automatically grant a 30-day temporary reserved pool (30k tokens) and email AE + Solutions for follow-up. This is gated under a simple verification event (form submission + domain allowlist).

Success metrics:
- Primary: 14-day active retention (engagement) uplift vs control.
- Secondary: SQL conversion rate within 60 days for accounts that submitted SQ; number of support tickets created during trial; net-dollar conversion after 90 days.
- Observability: token burn rate per session, median latency for prompts (ensure no infra impact).

Data & tracking:
- Events: credit_allocated, credit_consumed, sq_submitted, upgrade_clicked, upgrade_converted.
- Dashboards: cohorted retention, token burn distribution, SQ funnel (submission -> AE contact -> conversion).
- Measurement window: rolling 90 days with interim analysis at 14 and 30 days.

Rollout plan:
1) PRD + legal & security alignment (this ticket).
2) Engineering work: grant logic, TTL rules, SQ webhook + reserved pool automation (ENG implementation ticket to be created).
3) Small internal pilot (30 accounts) with manual SQ follow-up for first 2 weeks.
4) Gradual ramp to 25% of signups per cohort, then full experiment.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Credit exploitation by automated accounts. Mitigation: throttle new signup rate, strengthen anti-fraud signals, require email verification for high-velocity grants.
- Risk: Over-committing reserved pool for SQ gate leading to cost spike. Mitigation: cap reserved pool per workspace and implement quota checks; monitor usage daily.
- Risk: Confusion about multiple credit buckets. Mitigation: in-product education and a single credits UI that shows both bundles and expirations clearly.

Enterprise / Security Questionnaire (SQ) integration notes:
- The SQ checkpoint will be implemented as a webhook that triggers when the customer uploads or completes the SQ form. Initial implementation will accept only allowlisted domains for automatic reserved grants.
- Security needs to review data retention for SQ submissions and the log messages that trigger grants. Requesting Security review: see links.
- We will include a lightweight audit entry in the workspace activity log when the reserved pool is granted for compliance purposes.

Next steps:
- Finalize PRD and handoff to ENG (due 2025-11-12).
- Create ENG implementation tickets for grant engine, SQ webhook, and credits UI (blocked until security review).
- Design: two banner variants + credits UI mockups (see drive link).
